name: Return
idea: A single open orbit expresses returning to practice, with a deliberate gap that leaves room to keep learning.

name: Quiet Lamp
idea: A shallow bowl and one upright flame suggest understanding kindled through steady attention.

name: Review Spiral
idea: Two connected semicircles turn repetition inward, suggesting review that deepens understanding.

name: Measured Steps
idea: Three equal straight segments form a restrained ascending path, making progress feel deliberate rather than hurried.

name: Thinking Space
idea: Two balanced strokes turn the pause before an answer into a symbol of active thought.

name: Threshold
idea: An open-bottom doorway frames learning as something the learner must enter for themselves.

name: Connection
idea: Three branches meeting at one junction reduce the growing knowledge graph to its simplest meaningful form.

name: Steady Foundation
idea: A rounded triangle gives steady practice a stable base and a single upward direction.
